description: This is a shell script used to detect and select an iOS development team ID for code signing purposes. It gathers team IDs from various sources like Xcode preferences, legacy defaults, provisioning profiles, and keychain identities, and then determines the appropriate team ID based on user preferences or defaults.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Detect available Python interpreter from a set of candidates.

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Add a team ID, free status, and name to the respective lists if not already present.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Load team IDs from Xcode preferences plist.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Load team IDs from legacy defaults key.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Load team IDs from provisioning profiles.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Check if there is an Xcode developer account configured.
